identifier_normalization: Candidate ID and directory metadata normalized before the final full rerun; all scientific fields, grids, cutoffs, seeds, controls, and claim policies are unchanged.
purpose: Finite-k comparison of intrinsic Knauf h_k Dirichlet polynomials against pre-specified zeta-ratio identities and signed controls.

object.determinant_convention: partition function / finite Dirichlet polynomial; NOT a dynamical zeta or Fredholm determinant

grid_lock_rationale: Simple rational real parts and integer imaginary parts, selected before execution. No point was selected from a Riemann-zero table or from observed output.

random_sign_control.algorithm: SplitMix64 counter hash keyed by (base_seed,k,state_index); sign is determined by output bit 63
random_sign_control.level_policy: Each (base_seed,k) defines a distinct deterministic field; all seeds and all cutoffs are reported, with no best-seed selection.

allowed_data: algorithmically evaluated Euler phi, Liouville lambda, and Moebius mu
mpmath evaluations of the two pre-declared zeta ratios
forbidden_data: prime tables loaded from disk or network
dropping unfavorable seeds or grid points

claim_policy.Re_s_gt_2: finite-k numerical approach may be compared with the proved Dirichlet-series limit
claim_policy.1.5_lt_Re_s_le_2: analytic-continuation/boundary benchmark only; finite-k behavior is not a convergence or RH claim
claim_policy.Re_s_eq_2: boundary benchmark only; no convergence claim
